# JamboScript Documentation Site

This is a Docusaurus documentation site for JamboScript - a Swahili-based programming language.

## Project Setup

- Framework: Docusaurus 3.x
- Deployment: GitHub Pages
- Theme: Classic with custom vibrant styling

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

## Build for Production

```bash
npm run build
```

## Deploy to GitHub Pages

```bash
npm run deploy
```
